text:
Which statement about dilute hydrochloric acid is correct?
A
It is a strong acid as it fully dissociates.
B
It is a strong acid as it partially dissociates.
C
It is a weak acid as it fully dissociates.
D
It is a weak acid as it partially dissociates.

options.label: A
options.text: It is a strong acid as it fully dissociates.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a strong acid as it partially dissociates.

options.label: C
options.text: It is a weak acid as it fully dissociates.

options.label: D
options.text: It is a weak acid as it partially dissociates.
